div.div:
عَتَاهَةٌ a subst. from عُتِهَ [app. in all its senses; i. e., meaning Idiocy; &c.; though it might be supposed, from the manner in which it is mentioned, to be a subst. from عُتِهَ in the last only of the senses above assigned to it]; (K, TA;) as also ↓ عَتَاهِيَةٌ : (TA:) or each is an inf. n. of that verb [q. v.]. (Mgh, Msb.) ―
-b2- See also the next paragraph.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
